name: Swashbuckler Spear Dancer
body:
Spear dancers move through combat with an unparalleled grace, weaving through enemies as well as any ballroom.

Dancer’s Finesse (Ex)

A spear dancer’s swashbuckler finesse class feature also applies to two handed piercing melee weapons in the polearm or spear weapon groups and all deeds the spear dancer possess may be used with such weapons.

This ability modifies swashbuckler finesse.

Cloud Leap (Su)

Beginning with 1st level, whenever a spear dancer uses their derring-do deed to modify an Acrobatics check to jump, they halve the DC and are always considered to have a running start.

This ability modifies the derring-do deed.

Fast Movement (Ex)

Starting at 3rd level, a spear dancer gains fast movement as a monk of their class level.

This ability replaces all instances of charmed life.

Spear Dancing (Ex)

At 4th level, a spear dancer can enter a state of ecstasy while in combat. While wielding a two handed piercing melee weapon from the spear or polearm weapon group and fighting defensively or benefiting from the Combat Expertise feat, the spear dancer can attack targets an additional 5 feet away. If the weapon has reach they may also attack adjacent targets.

This ability replaces the bonus feat normally gained at 4th level.

Spear Dancer Training (Ex)

At 5th level, a spear dancer gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls with two-handed piercing melee weapons from the spear or polearm weapon group. Additionally, they gain the benefit of the Improved Critical feat while wielding such weapons. The bonus to attack and damage rolls increases by an additional +1 at 9th level and every 4 levels thereafter to a maximum of +4 at 17th level. This feature counts as weapon training for the purpose of feat prerequisites.

This ability replaces all instances of swashbuckler weapon training.
